description: The exact openings Printlooper would cut for a confirmed part at given fit settings, before a design is made around it.

clearance_mm.description: Gap per side around the part

columns.description: Parts per row along X. Must divide the count. Default is one row.

floor_hole_mm.description: Round hole through each pocket floor, for a screw or shaft. Pockets only.

mount.description: pocket keeps a floor under the part; through passes straight through a panel

pitch_mm.description: Centre-to-centre spacing. Required for more than one part.

plate_mm.description: Panel thickness for a through cutout. Through only.

taper_mm.description: Entry chamfer that helps the part go in. Pockets only.

name: preview_hardware_pocket
title: Pocket size for a part
